_meta.what: Annual-average official exchange rates (local currency units per US dollar) and consumer price indices (2010 = 100), by year, for converting historical price observations. Built by `node packages/atlas/build/12-prices.mjs fx`; do not edit by hand.

sources.name: Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)
sources.origin: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
sources.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators (source: IMF International Financial Statistics), CC BY 4.0

sources.name: Consumer price index (2010 = 100)
sources.origin: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
sources.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators (source: IMF International Financial Statistics), CC BY 4.0

sources.series: H.10 Taiwan dollar, daily noon buying rates, averaged by calendar year
sources.licenceType: Public domain (work of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System)
sources.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates

notes: fx[CODE][year]: one series per currency, taken from the country named in seriesOf. The World Bank expresses a redenominated currency in its current unit throughout; lib/prices.mjs scales the rate back for an observation older than the change.
A currency replaced by the euro (HRK, LTL, LVL, EEK) is held only to its last year; EUR is the World Bank euro-area aggregate.
peg:… series are fixed parities applied where the World Bank publishes none.
cpi[ISO2][year]: the country series as published. baseYear is the latest year of the US series.
Official rates are not street rates where a parallel market exists; lib/prices.mjs flags those country-years.
